results.snippet:
attempt=0
until curl --fail --silent "$ENDPOINT/health" > /dev/null; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  if [ "$attempt" -ge 30 ]; then
    echo "endpoint never became healthy" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done
echo "endpoint healthy after $attempt retries"

retry_policy:
  max_attempts: 5
  initial_backoff: 500ms
  max_backoff: 30s
  backoff_multiplier: 2.0
  retry_on:
    - connection_reset
    - upstream_timeout
    - status_503
  non_retryable:
    - status_400
    - status_401
